email.subject: Quick fix for Forge Fitness's site
email.body:
Hi Ravi,

I took a look at Forge Fitness's website and found two things likely costing you customers. There's no way to book a class online, so anyone browsing after hours just leaves. And your phone number isn't clickable on mobile, so people have to copy and dial it manually instead of tapping to call.

I fix exactly this kind of thing for local businesses for a flat fee. Happy to walk you through what I found on a free 10-minute call, no obligation.

Worth a quick look?

Alex
